name: Vacuum Shard (Canister Fragment)
description: A fragment of the Vacuum of Eternity's main canister, still containing traces of cosmic dust

interactions.examine: This shard is from the main body of the Vacuum of Eternity. You can still see swirls of cosmic dust trapped inside its translucent surface - the last remnants of its final use. It pulses rhythmically, like a heartbeat.
interactions.take: You grasp the canister shard. It's heavier than the others, as if it's carrying the weight of its purpose.
